summary: Tested the FIFO remaining-quantity fix for stock lots without changing any data (no sales, supplies or price saves). Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. GET /api/stock-lots returns initial_quantity, current_quantity and product_stock. For every product, current<=initial and the sum of current_quantity equals product_stock. PARACETAMOL 500MG: received 20 / remaining 18 / stock 18. IBUPROFENE 400MG: APP-ADB8B242-2 = 6 (received 12), IBU-B2 = 8, stock 14. /product/{id}/lots and /by-supply/{id} return the same values. PARACETAMOL movements sum to 18 (IN 20, OUT -1, OUT -1), matching products.stock. Frontend: the Gestion des prix column header reads 'Qté restante'. PARACETAMOL shows badge 18 with 'reçu 20'. IBUPROFENE shows 6 / reçu 12 and 8 (no 'reçu' line, as expected). The edit modal shows 'Quantité restante: 6 (reçu 12)' and closes with Escape without saving. In Nouvelle vente, searching 'para' shows PARACETAMOL 500MG with 'Stock: 18', the same value as Gestion des prix.

minor.issue: They do not call with_remaining. current_quantity is still item.quantity (the received quantity) and product_stock is missing, so they disagree with the list endpoints. Example: lot APP-ADB8B242-2 would return 12 instead of 6.

The main query does not filter on Supply.is_validated, but with_remaining only counts validated supplies. Lots from non-validated supplies therefore appear with current_quantity 0. Consider filtering them out or flagging them as 'non validé'.

issues: The date filter uses the browser's native date input, shown as 'mm/dd/yyyy' in English in a French app. Consider the shadcn Calendar date picker.

action_items: Apply with_remaining in GET /stock-lots/{lot_id} and PUT /stock-lots/{lot_id} so current_quantity and product_stock match the list endpoints
Optional: filter or flag lots from non-validated supplies in GET /stock-lots
critical_code_review_comments: stock_lots.py: lot_to_dict still sets current_quantity = item.quantity. Every endpoint that skips with_remaining (single GET, PUT) returns the received quantity.
with_remaining spreads products.stock across lots by expiry. This is an estimate, not real per-lot tracking. Acceptable, but it relies on sales not recording a lot ID.
